variants.description: Constraint-by-constraint QA verdict for the portable Flint realtime, security, provisioning, evidence, and React-release boundaries.

variants.name: validation
variants.description: Machine-readable deterministic QA results and explicit scope limits.

notes: This is a direct content/code QA artifact; the Flint change adds no visual UI surface.

Validation uses current focused tests, exact-head serialized full CI, cross-platform path rejection, repository-owned source/generated-output secret scanning with explicit dependency/cache exclusions, immutable external-source hashes, exact-head remote matrix state, strict OpenSpec, workflow lint, registry state, and diff hygiene.
The real SDK remains an explicit fail-closed immutable-source lane; the checked fixture remains the default portable CI contract.
